description:
Here's a description of the provided plot, following the requested guidelines:

The plot illustrates the change in a metric, CPC, across training iterations for two different models. The x-axis is labeled “Training Steps” and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 50 with tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled “CPC” and also has a linear scale, ranging from 1.2 to 2.2 with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. A black, solid line with circular markers represents the “SMoE Validating” model; it begins at approximately 2.1 at a training step of 0, declines to approximately 1.45 at a training step of 10, and then fluctuates between approximately 1.4 and 1.6, ending at approximately 1.55 at a training step of 50. A magenta, solid line with circular markers represents the “SimSMoE Validating” model; it begins at approximately 2.1 at a training step of 0, declines to approximately 1.4 at a training step of 10, and then fluctuates between approximately 1.4 and 1.55, ending at approximately 1.5 at a training step of 50.
